meta.name: game-world-design
meta.description: Design game experience, systems, and levels. Converge the chosen concept into one GAME_DESIGN defining the player promise, core loop, how the world responds, the systems actually needed, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a fully playable prototype. Use for design the game world, deepen the gameplay and levels, write the game design document, design the branching story structure, scenes, dialogue and consequences. 游戏体验、系统与关卡策划。把选定概念收束为一份 GAME_DESIGN，定义玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈、失败和可完整游玩的原型。用于设计游戏世界、深化玩法和关卡、设计互动叙事的场景对白与分支因果等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计游戏世界，把概念收束为可玩原型与设计文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在做游戏策划，需要把模糊想法变成可执行的设计方案。
copy.tagline_en: Design game worlds, systems, and levels into a playable prototype.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're turning a game concept into a playable prototype.

howto.what: 把选定的游戏概念整理成一份设计文档，写清玩家承诺、核心循环、世界怎么回应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈与失败，并给出可完整游玩的原型切片。
howto.when: 当用户给出 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、CONCEPT.md 和 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md，并要求设计游戏世界、深化玩法关卡或写互动叙事时触发。

say.text: 基于这份概念和简报，生成游戏设计文档。
深化核心循环和关卡节奏，只保留一个核心系统。
设计分支剧情、场景对话与因果，并写入叙事附件。
say.note: 叙事承载体验时才生成附件

howto.what_en: Converge the chosen concept into a GAME_DESIGN.md: define player promise, core loop, world response, necessary systems, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a playable prototype slice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides SOURCE_BIBLE.md, CONCEPT.md, and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md and asks to design the game world, deepen gameplay/levels, or write interactive narrative.

say_en.text: Generate a game design document from this concept and brief.
Deepen the core loop and level pacing, keep only one core system.
say_en.note: Follows the principle of minimal systems

say_en.text: Design branching story, scenes, dialogue, consequences.
say_en.note: Writes narrative appendix only when experience requires it.
